offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. Hobby: $19/month billed monthly, or $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month; paid-plan pay-as-you-go increments cost $5.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions 和 URLs，可选返回每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots。
offerings.note: Search results include query-relevant Highlights by default；费用按10个结果向上取整。
